d: While the history of the Koh-i-Noor and the British colonial looting of India is well-known, there is a modern, equally chilling chapter involving an individual of Indian origin who systematically hollowed out abandoned temples to amass a staggering fortune. This is not just a tale of greed, but a story of the dedicated investigators and activists who unearthed a massive international trafficking network to track down the heritage we all had thought was lost. This video goes beyond the mission of recovering valuable art and covers the incredible effort to bring these artifacts home,…
